# Lazy Cat Tools

> Simple, free browser tools. No sign-up, no accounts. Just the thing you needed.

Lazy Cat Tools (lazycattools.com) is a collection of lightweight, client-side utility tools designed for everyday use. All tools run entirely in the browser — no data is sent to a server, no accounts are required, and everything is free.

## Tools

<!-- randomizers:start (generated by _build/build-randomizers.mjs) -->
- [Secret Santa Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/secret-santa-generator/): Draw Secret Santa names for 3 to 100 people. Nobody draws themselves, couples or housemates can be kept apart, and each person gets a private link that shows only their own draw. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded or saved.

- [Spin the Wheel](https://lazycattools.com/tools/spin-the-wheel/): A wheel of names. Paste 2 to 100 names or choices, spin, and get a winner picked with the browser's secure random number generator (equal chance per slice; duplicates add slices). Remove winners as you go, load quick lists, go fullscreen for a classroom, and share a wheel by link.

- [Random Number Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-number-generator/): Generate 1 to 100 random numbers between any minimum and maximum, as whole numbers or decimals (0 to 6 places), with or without repeats. Uses crypto.getRandomValues in the browser.

- [Random Team Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-team-generator/): Split any list of names into random, balanced teams. Supports 2–10 teams, uneven group sizes, file upload (.txt/.csv), random team name generation, and shareable result links. Used by teachers, coaches, trivia hosts, and team leads.

- [Random Name Picker](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-name-picker/): Pick a random winner or participant from any list of names. Useful for giveaways, classroom callouts, raffle draws, and any situation where you need an impartial pick.

- [Dice Roller](https://lazycattools.com/tools/dice-roller/): Roll 1 to 10 dice of one type (d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 or d100) with a modifier from -10 to +10. Shows each die, the sum and a history of the last 20 rolls. Uses crypto.getRandomValues.

- [Giveaway Winner Picker](https://lazycattools.com/tools/giveaway-winner-picker/): Paste up to 1,000 giveaway entries, remove duplicates, and draw 1 to 10 winners plus up to 5 alternates, all different people, with a timestamped result to screenshot. Uses a Fisher–Yates draw with crypto.getRandomValues.

- [Random Order Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-order-generator/): Shuffle a list of 2 to 500 items into a random numbered order. Every item appears exactly once. Uses a Fisher–Yates shuffle with crypto.getRandomValues.

- [Coin Flip](https://lazycattools.com/tools/coin-flip/): Flip a virtual coin and get an instant heads or tails result. Simple 50/50 decision-making tool.

- [Yes or No Decision Maker](https://lazycattools.com/tools/yes-or-no/): Get a random Yes, No or Maybe for a question, with adjustable odds (45/45/10 by default). Uses crypto.getRandomValues; the question stays in the browser.

- [Random Team Name Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-team-name-generator/): Generate 1 to 10 team names at a time from five themes (Gaming, Trivia, Sports, Work, Silly), each built from in-page word lists. Uses crypto.getRandomValues.

- [Random Password Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-password-generator/): Generate a password of 8 to 64 characters from lowercase, uppercase, numbers and symbols, optionally without look-alike characters, with a strength estimate in bits. Made with crypto.getRandomValues in the browser; never saved or sent.
<!-- randomizers:end -->

## Kitchen

- [Kitchen & Baking Converters](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/): Hub for all kitchen tools and ingredient charts.
- [Recipe Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/recipe-converter/): Paste a whole recipe and convert every line to grams, or back to cups.
- [Recipe Scaler](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/recipe-scaler/): Halve, double or resize a recipe by servings, in real kitchen measures.
- [Cups, Tablespoons & Teaspoons](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/cups-tablespoons-teaspoons/): 1 cup = 16 tbsp = 48 tsp, plus fluid ounces and ml.
- [Butter Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/butter-converter/): Sticks to cups, tablespoons and grams, and European blocks to sticks.
- [Oven Temperature Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/oven-temperature/): °F, °C and gas mark, with fan oven settings.
- [Pan Size Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/pan-size-converter/): Baking in a different pan? Get the number to multiply your recipe by.
- [Air Fryer Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/air-fryer-converter/): Turn oven temperature and time into air fryer settings, and back.
- [Meat Temperature & Cooking Time](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/meat-temperature/): Safe USDA temperatures, rest times and roasting estimates.
- [Coffee Ratio Calculator](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/coffee-ratio/): Grams of coffee and water for drip, French press, cold brew or espresso.
- [Rice to Water Ratio](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/rice-to-water-ratio/): Water and cooking time for six kinds of rice, stovetop or Instant Pot.
- [Ingredient Substitutions](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/ingredient-substitutions/): Out of eggs, honey, chocolate or the right salt? Swap with the right amount.
- [Cup Fraction Calculator](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/cup-fraction-calculator/): Turn 0.66 cups into ⅔ cup, or the spoons that add up to it.
- [Instant Pot Cooking Times](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/pressure-cooker-times/): Searchable pressure cooker times and release types.
- [Turkey Cooking Time Calculator](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/turkey-cooking-time/): Roasting time, temperature, rest and thawing days by weight.
- [Cups to Grams Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/cups-to-grams/): Convert cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, grams and ounces for 28 baking ingredients, using ingredient-specific weights (e.g. 1 cup all-purpose flour = 120 g, spooned and leveled).

<!-- word-games:start (generated by _build/build-word-games.mjs) -->
## Word Games

- [Word Unscrambler](https://lazycattools.com/word-games/word-unscrambler/): Enter 2 to 15 jumbled letters and get every word they make, grouped by length, longest first. Filter by length, first letter, last letter or a letter it must contain. Uses a built-in list of about 60,000 common English words (SCOWL); nothing is sent anywhere.

- [Anagram Solver](https://lazycattools.com/word-games/anagram-solver/): Find anagrams: words that use every letter you enter exactly once (2 to 15 letters). Same built-in word list as the Word Unscrambler; runs in the browser.

- [Scrabble Word Finder](https://lazycattools.com/word-games/scrabble-word-finder/): Enter a Scrabble rack of 2 to 7 tiles, with up to 2 blanks as ? or _, and get the words it makes sorted by Scrabble score (standard tile values, blanks worth 0, no board bonuses). Uses a common-English word list, not an official Scrabble dictionary.

- [Word Counter](https://lazycattools.com/word-games/word-counter/): Paste text to count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading time (200 words a minute), speaking time (130 words a minute) and the most-used words. The text stays in the browser.
<!-- word-games:end -->

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://lazycattools.com/): Tool directory listing all available tools.
- [About](https://lazycattools.com/pages/about/): Background on the site and its philosophy.
- [Contact](https://lazycattools.com/pages/contact/): Email for bug reports, corrections, and tool requests.
- [Privacy Policy](https://lazycattools.com/pages/privacy/): Tools run client-side; nothing typed into a tool is sent to a server. Google Analytics and AdSense cookies are explained.
- [Terms of Use](https://lazycattools.com/pages/terms/): Free to use; results provided as-is.

## About This Site

- **Owner:** Lazy Cat Tools / Culwell Creations
- **Monetization:** Google AdSense display ads
- **Tech stack:** Static HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript — hosted on Cloudflare Pages
- **Philosophy:** Ship simple tools fast, keep them free, no accounts or data collection
